evals.prompt: We need to design and plan a new user authentication feature with OAuth2 and passkeys.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive requirements.md, design.md, and tasks.md documents with subagent review approvals and derived localized translations in the user's conversation language.
assertions: The agent conducts an incremental requirements elicitation dialogue enforcing mutual exit criteria (user sign-off and assistant verification)
The agent evaluates existing specs under docs/specs/ and seeks user confirmation on consolidation strategy (duplicate, sub-scope, super-scope, or new)
The agent conducts codebase reconnaissance to verify technical feasibility and finalize authoring inputs
The agent normalizes the feature name into a kebab-case directory under docs/specs/
The agent drafts requirements.md adhering to EARS syntax, RFC 2119 / RFC 8174 keywords, and ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 characteristics
The agent validates requirements.md with the requirements-reviewer subagent until APPROVED
The agent drafts design.md specifying Component Contracts (DbC) with RFC 2119 keywords, JSON Schema constraints, and RFC 9457 error format
The agent records architectural decisions via the decision-analyst subagent
The agent validates design.md with the design-reviewer subagent until APPROVED
The agent drafts tasks.md decomposing work into Stacked PRs with GFM checkbox tracking and a mechanical traceability matrix
The agent validates tasks.md with the tasks-reviewer subagent until APPROVED
The agent generates derived bilingual translations (*.<lang>.md) using standard RFC 2119 localized mapping for the conversation language
The agent delegates final commit and PR creation to drafting-pull-request

evals.prompt: Fix a small typo in the login button text.
evals.expected_output: Task suitability check detects that the change is lightweight and suggests direct editing rather than heavy SDD specification process.
assertions: The agent checks task suitability in Step 2
The agent flags the task as too lightweight for SDD (typo / 1-line change)
The agent offers the user the choice to bypass SDD and gracefully terminates if bypass is accepted
